t: OX Pro 7" (180mm) rafter square features a durable aluminium construction, engineered for precision and longevity on construction sites. The robust square includes integrated distance and angle scales, allowing for quick and accurate readings crucial for tasks such as framing, roofing, and general carpentry. The white laser-etched markings ensure optimal visibility of numbers even in challenging lighting conditions, supporting efficient workflow for carpenters and roofers across various projects. Weather-resistant and built for tough outdoor work environments, making it a reliable addition to professional toolkits.
